properties.name: Priyadarshini Jurala Project
properties.source_terms: TGRAC website disclaimer describes site information as for non-commercial teaching, research, and extension; no standard data license stated. Academic research use; retain attribution; do not redistribute raw source without further terms confirmation.
properties.historical_crosscheck: TGRAC Kharif 2014-15 report lists Priyadarshini Jurala Project ayacut as 42,405 ha, matching this feature attribute.
properties.study_period_basis: TGRAC All Crops Survey CTO Records today date field; observed form dates 2021-08-27 through 2021-10-22 for matched Jurala records.
properties.limitations: Current TGRAC service snapshot, not a legal cadastral certification. Crop labels are Paddy-dominated; this AOI/data support a limited feasibility study only, not broad multi-crop performance or irrigation-advisory validation.
